cohort: Patients undergoing single frozen-thawed blastocyst transfer (SFBT) cycles were divided into groups based on the morphological grading of the transferred blastocysts (good-quality vs. poor-quality).
finding: The quality of blastocysts did not significantly affect perinatal outcomes, including obstetric and neonatal outcomes, in single frozen-thawed blastocyst transfer (SFBT) cycles.
mod_finding: No statistically significant differences were found in the incidence of cesarean delivery between women receiving SFBT with different blastocyst qualities.
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome, no specific inclusion range mentioned.
